chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador began by his Advent
chapter_note: A compact numbered schematic of ten cosmological operations triggered by the Third Ambassador’s advent. Aside from the single dialogue attribution in ¶1 (hagiographic frame), the chapter stays entirely within the cosmic system (ships, wheels, doors, separation of Night/Day, Sin, abortions, transmigrations) and reads like an old structural list rather than institutional application or NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: The Ambassador performed ten works by his advent.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: "Once again the enlightener speaks:" (hagiographic wrapper).
paragraphs.temporal_note: The attribution "the enlightener speaks" is a classic Kephalaia frame marker; the remaining clause functions as a schematic heading introducing a cosmological ten-fold list.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.87⟩
The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal enumerated cosmological sequencing ("The first...") with named cosmic functionary (Great Builder) acting within the aeonic architecture; no institutional pointing.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmos→cosmos description of the ships’ motion in the heavens; numbered schematic list style characteristic of teaching substrates.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mechanistic cosmological process language (wheels sending life) within the purification machine; no exhortation/citation.
Though lacunose, it is a continued numbered item in the same cosmological ten-work sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [ ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the internal cosmic machinery register (doors of the ships opening); no contemporary/institutional mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth is the doors too [ ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still a functional description within the cosmic system (doors opened to receive waste), consistent with purification mechanics.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic event narration within the system: a personified entity (Sin) separated from rulers due to the Third Ambassador’s action; no moral exhortation or institutional polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: The eighth: Night and day were separated [ ... ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological ordering (separation of Night/Day) as a stage in the machine; remains entirely within cosmic process language.

paragraphs.core_text: The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief schematic notice of a mythic-cosmological consequence (abortions falling), not a pastoral warning; continues the numbered operations.

paragraphs.core_text: The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the ten-fold cosmic sequence with a structural result (transmigrations in the zone), still non-institutional and non-NT.
